SELECT y.id, y.emp_id, y.year, y.bonus_amount, y.tax_amount, y.net_amount, y.created_at, y.updated_at, e.name, d.dept_name FROM year_end_bonus y INNER JOIN employee e ON y.emp_id = e.id LEFT JOIN dept d ON e.dept_id = d.id
AND y.year = #{year} AND y.emp_id = #{empId} AND e.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
ORDER BY y.year DESC, e.name
SELECT y.*, e.name, d.dept_name AS deptName FROM year_end_bonus y INNER JOIN employee e ON y.emp_id = e.id LEFT JOIN dept d ON e.dept_id = d.id WHERE y.id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM year_end_bonus WHERE emp_id = #{empId} AND year = #{year}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO year_end_bonus (emp_id, year, bonus_amount, tax_amount, net_amount) VALUES (#{empId}, #{year}, #{bonusAmount}, #{taxAmount}, #{netAmount})
